biography: Ph.D. Candidate in Sustainability Education at Prescott College, NSF Research Fellow, and accredited Independent International Expert (OMEI Geneva N°2688). Expert Contributor to the ITU-T Focus Group on AI for Smart Cities (FG-AI4SSC) and Africa AI Policy Fellow. Co-author of the Africa AI Governance Index 2026, specializing in AI-enabled resilience of critical infrastructure, cybersecurity governance, and digital sustainability across the Global South.
